metadata.title: Donaldson-Sun Theory in the Conic Case
metadata.abstract: We extend the Donaldson-Sun theory of metric tangent cones to non-collapsing Gromov-Hausdorff limits of conical Kahler-Einstein pairs whose boundary coefficients lie in a fixed finite subset of Q, and prove uniqueness of the log metric tangent cone. Furthermore, under a mild lc compatibility condition, we relate this with the Li-Xu and Li-Liu-Xu stable degeneration machinery. We also construct polarized smooth Kaehler metrics on CP^2 with a uniform lower Ricci bound and volume non-collapsing, whose limit has nonunique tangent cones, showing that the Kahler-Einstein assumption is crucial for rigidity.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 把 Donaldson--Sun 的度量切锥理论推广到锥形 Kähler--Einstein 对的非塌缩 Gromov--Hausdorff 极限，并证明对数度量切锥唯一。
analysis.breakthrough: 把解析切锥与 Li--Xu、Li--Liu--Xu 的稳定退化机制衔接；同时构造非 Einstein 极限的非唯一切锥例子，说明刚性的边界。
analysis.limitations: 边界系数须来自固定有限有理数集，代数对应还需要轻微的 lc 相容条件。
analysis.priorityReason: 100 分制：相关性 24/30、新颖性与强度 18/25、技术复用性 14/20、潜在影响 10/15、证据清晰度 8/10，总分 74/100。
